info.name: Raise Hand API (HW3 · DRF)
info.description:
Live Q&A for lectures — Django REST Framework + PostgreSQL in Docker Compose.

Run the folders in order (or the whole collection with the Collection Runner / newman): folder 1 creates a lecture and stores its id/code in collection variables, folder 2 creates, edits and deletes a question in it, folder 3 deletes the lecture, folder 4 shows the error responses.

Variables: baseUrl (default http://localhost:8000), voter (identifies the upvoter), lecture_id / lecture_code / question_id (filled automatically).

Docs: {{baseUrl}}/docs/ (Swagger UI), docs/API.md in the repository.

item.name: 1 · Lectures (CRUD)
item.description: Create → read (by id and by code) → update (PUT and PATCH) → the delete is in folder 3, after the questions.

request.description: All lectures with their question counts, newest first. Query: ?search=<title or code> ?is_open=true|false ?ordering=title|-created_at|question_count ?limit=&offset=.

exec: // Assertions run after the response arrives (see the Test Results tab).

pm.test("Paginated: count, next, previous, results[]", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.count).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(b.results).to.be.an("array"); pm.expect(b).to.have.keys("count", "next", "previous", "results"); });
// Assertions run after the response arrives (see the Test Results tab).

pm.test("Every result is open and matches the search", () => { for (const l of pm.response.json().results) { pm.expect(l.is_open).to.be.true; pm.expect(l.title.toLowerCase()).to.include("flutter"); } });

item.name: 2 · Questions (CRUD)
item.description: Create → read → update → upvote/answered actions → delete. Uses the lecture created in folder 1.

request.description: Creates a question inside the lecture; its id is stored for the next requests.

exec: // Assertions run after the response arrives (see the Test Results tab).
pm.test("Belongs to our lecture", () => { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.lecture_id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("lecture_id"))); pm.expect(b.votes).to.eql(0); });
// Assertions run after the response arrives (see the Test Results tab).
pm.test("Contains the new question", () => { const ids = pm.response.json().results.map(q => q.id); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("question_id"))); });

request.description: Every question in the database (demo data = 100+ rows). Query: ?lecture=<id|code> ?is_answered=true|false ?search= ?ordering=votes|-votes|created_at ?limit=&offset=.
